Veshav Adonai elohecha et-shevutecha verichamecha veshav vekibbetzcha mikkol-haammim asher hefitzcha Adonai elohecha shamma
Vituv Adonai elahach yat shave galvatach viracham alach vituv veyichneshinnach mikkol ammayya di yevadderinnach Adonai elahach letamman
Im-yihye niddachacha biktze hashshamayim mishsham yekabbetzcha Adonai elohecha umishsham yikkachecha
Im yehe galvatach bisyafe shemayya mittamman yichneshinnach Adonai elahach umittamman yekarvinnach
Veheviacha Adonai elohecha el-haaretz asher-yarshu avotecha virishtahh vehetivcha vehirbecha meavotecha
Veyaelinnach Adonai elahach leara diritu avahatach vetertahh veotev lach veyasguinnach meavahatach
Umal Adonai elohecha et-levavcha veet-levav zarecha leahava et-Adonai elohecha bechol-levavcha uvechol-nafshecha lemaan chayyecha
Veyede Adonai elahach yat tafshut libbach veyat tafshut libba divnach lemircham yat Adonai elahach bechol libbach uvechol nafshach bedil chayyach
Venatan Adonai elohecha et kol-haalot haelle al-oyvecha veal-sonecha asher redafucha
Veyitten Adonai elahach yat kol levatayya ha'illen al baale devavach veal sanach di redafuche
Veatta tashuv veshamata bekol Adonai veassita et-kol-mitzotav asher anochi metzavvecha hayyom
Veatte tetuv utekabbal bememra da-Adonai vetabed yat kol pikkudohi di ana mefakkedach yoma den
Vehotircha Adonai elohecha bechol maasse yadecha bifri vitnecha uvifri vehemtecha uvifri admatcha letova ki yashuv Adonai lassus alecha letov kaasher-sas al-avotecha
Veotrinnach Adonai elahach bechol ovade yedach bevalda dimach uvevalda divirach uve'ibba dearach letava are yetuv Adonai lemechede alach letav kema di chadi al avahatach
Ki tishma bekol Adonai elohecha lishmor mitzotav vechukkotav hakketuva bessefer hattora hazze ki tashuv el-Adonai elohecha bechol-levavcha uvechol-nafshecha
Are tekabbal bememra dayya elahach lemittar pikkudohi ukeyamohi dichtivin bessifra deorayta haden are tetuv kodam Adonai elahach bechol libbach uvechol nafshach
Ki hammitzva hazzot asher anochi metzavvecha hayyom lo-niflet hiv mimmecha velo rechoka hiv
Are tafkedta hada di ana mefakkedach yoma den la mafresha hi minnach vela rechika hi
Lo vashshamayim hiv lemor mi yaale-lanu hashshamayma veyikkacheha lanu veyashmienu otahh venaassenna
La vishmayya hi lememar man yissak lana lishmayya veyissevahh lana veyashme'innana yatahh venabedinnahh
Velo-meever layyam hiv lemor mi yaavar-lanu el-ever hayyam veyikkacheha lanu veyashmienu otahh venaassenna
Vela me'ivra leyamma hi lememar man ye'ivar lana le'ivra deyamma veyissevahh lana veyashme'innana yatahh venabedinnahh
Ki-karov elecha haddavar meod beficha uvilvavcha laassoto
Are kariv lach pitgama lachada befumach uvelibbach lemebedehh
Ree natatti lefanecha hayyom et-hachayyim veet-hattov veet-hammavet veet-hara
Chaze dihavit kodamach yoma den yat chayye veyat tavta veyat mota veyat bisha

Asher anochi metzavvecha hayyom leahava et-Adonai elohecha lalechet bidrachav velishmor mitzotav vechukkotav umishpatav vechayita veravita uverachcha Adonai elohecha baaretz asher-atta va-shamma lerishtahh

Di ana mefakkedach yoma den lemircham yat Adonai elahach limhach bearchan detaknan kodamohi ulemittar pikkudohi ukeyamohi vedinohi veteche vetisgue vivarechinnach Adonai elahach beara di atte alel letamman lemertahh
Ve'im-yifne levavcha velo tishma veniddachta vehishtachavita lelohim acherim vaavadtam
Ve'im yifne libbach vela tekabbel vetite vetisgud letaavat ammayya vetiflechinnun
Higgadti lachem hayyom ki avod tovedun lo-taarichun yamim al-haadama asher atta over et-hayyarden lavo shamma lerishtahh
Chavveti lechon yoma den are mevad tevdun la torchon yomin al ara di atte aver yat yardena lemeal letamman lemertahh
Ha'idoti vachem hayyom et-hashshamayim veet-haaretz hachayyim vehammavet natatti lefanecha habberacha vehakkelala uvacharta bachayyim lemaan tichye atta vezarecha
Ashedit bechon yoma den yat shemayya veyat ara chayye umota yehavit kodamach birchan ulevatin vetittire bechayye bedil deteche atte uvenach
Leahava et-Adonai elohecha lishmoa bekolo uledavka-vo ki hu chayyecha veorech yamecha lashevet al-haadama asher nishba Adonai laavotecha leavraham leyitzchak uleyaakov latet lahem
Lemircham yat Adonai elahach lekabbala lememrehh ule'itkarava ledachaltehh are hu chayyach veorachut yomach lemittav al ara di kayyim Adonai laavahatach leavraham leyitzchak uleyaakov lemittan lehon
Vayyelech moshe vaydabber et-haddevarim haelle el-kol-yisrael
Vaazal mshe umallil yat pitgamayya ha'illen im kol yisrael
Vayyomer alehem ben-mea veesrim shana anochi hayyom lo-uchal od latzet velavo va-Adonai amar elay lo taavor et-hayyarden hazze
Vaamar lehon bar mea veesrin shenin ana yoma den let ana yachil od lemippak ulemeal va-Adonai amar li la te'ibbar yat yardena haden
Adonai elohecha hu over lefanecha hu-yashmid et-haggoyim haelle millefanecha virishtam yehoshua hu over lefanecha kaasher dibber Adonai
Adonai elahach memrehh ye'ivar kodamach hu yeshetze yat ammayya ha'illen mikkodamach vetertinnun yehoshua hu aver kodamach kema di mallil Adonai
Veassa Adonai lahem kaasher assa lessichon uleog malche haemori uleartzam asher hishmid otam
Veyabed Adonai lehon kema di avad lessichon uleog malche emoraa ulearahon di shetzi yathon
Unetanam Adonai lifnechem vaassitem lahem kechol-hammitzva asher tzivviti etchem
Veyimserinnun Adonai kodamechon vetabedun lehon kechol tafkedta di fakkedit yatchon
Chizku ve'imtzu al-tiru veal-taartzu mippenehem ki Adonai elohecha hu haholech immach lo yarpecha velo yaazvekka
Tekifu veallimu la tidchalun vela tittavrun mikkodamehon are Adonai elahach hu dimdabbar kodamach la yishbekinnach vela yarteshinnach
Vayyikra moshe lihoshua vayyomer elav leene chol-yisrael chazak veematz ki atta tavo et-haam hazze el-haaretz asher nishba Adonai laavotam latet lahem veatta tanchilenna otam
Ukera mshe lihoshua vaamar lehh leene chol yisrael tekaf veallim are atte teul im amma haden leara di kayyim Adonai laavahathon lemittan lehon veatte tachseninnahh yathon
Va-Adonai hu haholech lefanecha hu yihye immach lo yarpecha velo yaazvekka lo tira velo techat
Va-Adonai hu dimdabbar kodamach memrehh yehe vessadach la yishbekinnach vela yarchekinnach la tidchal vela tittevar
Vayyichtov moshe et-hattora hazzot vayyittenahh el-hakkohanim bene levi hannossim et-aron berit Adonai veel-kol-zikne yisrael
Uchetav mshe yat orayta hada vihavahh lechahanayya bene levi denatlin yat aron keyama da-Adonai ulechol save yisrael
Vaytzav moshe otam lemor mikketz sheva shanim bemoed shenat hashshemitta bechag hassukkot
Ufakkid mshe yathon lememar missof sheva shenin bizman shatta dishmitteta bechagga dimtallayya
Bevo chol-yisrael leraot et-pene Adonai elohecha bammakom asher yivchar tikra et-hattora hazzot negued kol-yisrael beaznehem
Bemete chol yisrael le'itchazaa kodam Adonai elahach beatra di yittire tikre yat orayta hada kodam kol yisrael vetashme'innun
Hachel et-haam haanashim vehannashim vehattaf veguercha asher bisharecha lemaan yishmeu ulemaan yilmedu veyaru et-Adonai elohechem veshamru laassot et-kol-divre hattora hazzot
Kenosh yat amma guvrayya uneshayya vetafla veguiyyorach di vekirvach bedil deyishmeun uvedil deyillefun veyidchalun mikkodam Adonai elahachon veyitterun lemebad yat kol pitgame orayta hada
Uvenehem asher lo-yadu yishmeu velamdu leyira et-Adonai elohechem kol-hayyamim asher attem chayyim al-haadama asher attem ovrim et-hayyarden shamma lerishtahh
Uvenehon di la yadun yishmeun veyallefun lemidchal yat Adonai elahachon kol yomayya di attun kayyamin al ara di attun avrin yat yardena tamman lemertahh
Vayyomer Adonai el-moshe hen karvu yamecha lamut kera et-yehoshua vehityatztzevu beohel moed vaatzavvennu vayyelech moshe vihoshua vayyityatztzevu beohel moed
Vaamar Adonai lemshe ha kerivu yomach limmat kera yat yehoshua ve'itattadu bemashkan zimna veefakkedinnehh vaazal mshe vihoshu ve'itattadu bemashkan zimna
Vayyera Adonai baohel beammud anan vayyaamod ammud heanan al-petach haohel
Ve'itgueli Adonai bemashkena beammuda daanana vekam ammuda daanana al tera mashkena
Vayyomer Adonai el-moshe hinnecha shochev im-avotecha vekam haam hazze vezana achare elohe nechar-haaretz asher hu va-shamma bekirbo vaazavani vehefer et-beriti asher karatti itto
Vaamar Adonai lemshe ha atte shachev im avahatach vikum amma haden veyite batar taavat amme ara di hu al tamman benehon veyishbekun dachalti veyashnun yat keyami di guezarit immehon
Vechara appi vo vayyom-hahu vaazavtim vehistarti fanay mehem vehaya leechol umetzauhu raot rabbot vetzarot veamar bayyom hahu halo al ki-en elohay bekirbi metzauni haraot haelle

Veyitkof ragzi vehon beoma hahu vearchekinnun veessallek shechinti minnehon vihon lemibbaz veyiaran yathon bishan sagguian veakan veyemar beoma hahu hala middelet shechinat elahay beni aruni bishayya ha'illen
Veanochi haster astir panay bayyom hahu al kol-haraa asher assa ki fana el-elohim acherim
Vaana sallaka essallek shechinti minnehon beoma hahu al kol bisha di avadu are itpeniyyu letaavat ammayya
Veatta kitvu lachem et-hashshira hazzot velammedahh et-bene-yisrael simahh befihem lemaan tihye-li hashshira hazzot leed bivne yisrael
Uchean ketivu lechon yat tushbachta hada veallefahh yat bene yisrael shavveyahh befumhon bedil dithe kodamay tushbachta hada lessahid bivne yisrael
Ki-aviennu el-haadama asher-nishbati laavotav zavat chalav udevash veachal vessava vedashen ufana el-elohim acherim vaavadum veniatzuni vehefer et-beriti
Are aelinnun leara di kayyemit laavahathon avda chalav udevash veyechlun veyisbeun veyitpannekun veyitpenun batar taavat ammayya veyiflechunnun veyirguezun kodamay veyashnun yat keyami
Vehaya ki-timtzena oto raot rabbot vetzarot veanta hashshira hazzot lefanav leed ki lo tishshachach mippi zaro ki yadati et-yitzro asher hu osse hayyom beterem aviennu el-haaretz asher nishbati

Vihe are yearan yatehh bishan sagguian veakan vetatev tushbachta hada kodamohi lessahid are la titneshe mippum benehon are guele kodamay yat yitzrehon di innun avdin yoma den ad la aelinnun leara di kayyemit
Vayyichtov moshe et-hashshira hazzot bayyom hahu vaylammedahh et-bene yisrael
Uchetav mshe yat tushebbachta hada beoma hahu veallefinnahh livne yisrael
Vaytzav et-yehoshua bin-nun vayyomer chazak veematz ki atta tavi et-bene yisrael el-haaretz asher-nishbati lahem veanochi ehye immach
Ufakkid yat yehoshua bar nun vaamar tekef veallim are atte tael yat bene yisrael leara di kayyemit lehon umemri yehe vessaaddach
Vayhi kechallot moshe lichtov et-divre hattora-hazzot al-sefer ad tummam
Vahava kad shetze mshe lemichtav yat pitgame orayta hada al sifra ad dishlimu
Vaytzav moshe et-halviyyim nosse aron berit-Adonai lemor
Ufakkid mshe yat levae natle aron keyama da-Adonai lememar
Lakoach et sefer hattora hazze vessamtem oto mitztzad aron berit-Adonai elohechem vehaya-sham becha leed
Sivu yat sifra deorayta haden uteshauun yatehh missetar arona keyama da-Adonai elahachon vihe tamman bach lessahid
Ki anochi yadati et-meryecha veet-arpecha hakkashe hen beodenni chay immachem hayyom mamrim heyitem im-Adonai veaf ki-achare moti
Are ana yedana yat sarvanutach veyat kedalach dekashya ha vead ana kayyam immechon yoma den messarvin havetun kodam Adonai veaf are batar deemut
Hachilu elay et-kol-zikne shivtechem veshotrechem vaadabbera veaznehem et haddevarim haelle vea'ida bam et-hashshamayim veet-haaretz
Kenishu levati yat kol save shivtechon vessarchechon veemallel kodamehon yat pitgamayya ha'illen veashed behon yat shemayya veyat ara
Ki yadati achare moti ki-hashchet tashchitun vessartem min-hadderech asher tzivviti etchem vekarat etchem haraa beacharit hayyamim ki-taassu et-hara beene Adonai lehachisso bemaasse yedechem
Are yedana batar deemut are chabbala techabbelun vetistun min archa di fakkedit yatchon uteara yatchon bishta bessof yomayya are tabedun yat devish kodam Adonai leargaza kodamohi beovade yedechon
Vaydabber moshe beazne kol-kehal yisrael et-divre hashshira hazzot ad tummam
Umallil mshe kodam kol kehala deyisrael yat pitgame tushebbachta hada ad dishlimu
Haazinu hashshamayim vaadabbera vetishma haaretz imre-fi
Atzitu shemayya veemallel vetishshema ara imre fummi
Yaarof kammatar likchi tizzal kattal imrati kissirim ale-deshe vechirvivim ale-essev
Yevassam kemitra ulpani yitkabbal ketalla memri keruche mitra denashvin al dita vechirsisse malkosha di al isba
Ki shem Adonai ekra havu godel lelohenu
Are bishma da-Adonai ana metzalle havu revuta kodam elahana
Hatztzur tamim paolo ki chol-derachav mishpat el emuna veen avel tzaddik veyashar hu
Takkifa deshalmin ovadohi are kol rchatehh dina elaha mehemna demin kodamohi avla la nafek demin kodam zakkay vekashshit hu
Shichet lo lo banav mumam dor ikkesh ufetaltol
Chabbilu lehon la lehh benayya di felachu letaavata dara deashniyyu ovadohi ve'ishtanniyyu
Ha-la-Adonai tigmelu-zot am naval velo chacham halo-hu avicha kanecha hu ascha vaychonnecha
Ha kodam Adonai attun gamlin da amma dekabbilu orayta vela chakkimu hala hu avuche veatte di lehh hu avdach veatkenach
Zechor yemot olam binu shenot dor-vador sheal avicha veyagguedcha zekenecha veyomru lach
Idkar yomin demin alma istakkal bishne dar vedar sheal avuche vichavvi lach savich veyemrun lach
Behanchel elyon goyim behafrido bene adam yatztzev guevulot ammim lemispar bene yisrael
Beachassana illaa ammayya befarashutehh bene anasha kayyim techume ammayya leminyan bene yisrael
Ki chelek Adonai ammo yaakov chevel nachalato
Are cholaka da-Adonai ammehh yaakv adav achassantehh
Yimtzaehu beeretz midbar uvetohu yelel yeshimon yessovvenhu yevonnehu yitztzerenhu ke'ishon eno
Sappik tzarkehon beara madbera uvet tzachavana ater di let mayya ashrinnun sechor sechor leshechintehh allefinnun pitgame orayta netarinnun kevavat enehon
Kenesher ya'ir kinno al-gozalav yerachef yifros kenafav yikkachehu yissaehu al-evrato
Kenishra dimchish lekinnehh al benohi mitchofef paris gadpohi mekabbelhon menattelhon al tekof evarohi
Adonai badad yanchennu veen immo el nechar
Adonai bilchodohi atid leashrayutehon bealma dehu atid le'itchaddata vela yitkayyam kodamohi palchan taavan
Yarkivehu al-vmvty bbamote aretz vayyochal tenuvot saday vayyenikehu devash missela veshemen mechalmish tzur
Ashrinnun al takfe ara veochalinnun bizzat sanehon vihav lehon bizzat shallite kirvin venichse yatve kerakkin takkifin
Chemat bakar vachalev tzon im-chelev karim veelim bene-vashan veattudim im-chelev kilyot chitta vedam-enav tishte-chamer
Yehav lehon bizzat malchehon veshallitehon im tar ravrevehon vetakkifehon ama dearahon veachassantehon im bizzat chelehon umashshiryathon vedam guibbarehon yittashad kemayya
Vayyishman yeshurun vayyivat shamanta avita kassita vayyittosh eloha assahu vaynabbel tzur yeshuato
Veattar yisrael uveat atzlach tekof kena nichsin ushevak palchan elaha deavdehh vearguez kodam takkifa defarkehh
Yakniuhu bezarim betoevot yachissuhu
Akniu kodamohi befalchan taavan betoevta arguizu kodamohi
Yizbechu lashshedim lo eloha elohim lo yedaum chadashim mikkarov bau lo searum avotechem
Dabbachu leshedin dilet behon tzeroch dachalan dela yedaunnun chadta di mikkariv itavida la itassaku vehon avahatchon
Tzur yeladcha teshi vattishkach el mechollecha
Dachala takkifa divraach itnesheta shevakta palchan elaha deavdach
Vayyar Adonai vayyinatz mikkaas banav uvenotav
Ugueli kodam Adonai utekef ragzehh midarguizu kadamohi benin uvenan
Vayyomer astira fanay mehem ere ma acharitam ki dor tahpuchot hemma banim lo-emun bam
Vaamar essalek shechinti minnehon gueli kodamay ma yehe vessofehon are dara deashniyyu innun benayya dilet behon hemanu
Hem kinuni velo-el kiassuni behavlehem vaani akniem belo-am bego naval achissem
Innun akniu kodamay bela dachala arguizu kodamay befalchan taavan vaana akninnun bela am beamma tafsha arguezinnun
Ki-esh kadcha veappi vattikad ad-sheol tachtit vattochal eretz vivulahh vattelahet mosde harim
Are kiddum takkif keeshsha nefak mikkodamay birgaz veshetze ad sheol ara'it veassef ara vaalaltahh veshetziyyat ad seyafe turayya
Aspe alemo raot chitztzay achalle-bam
Assef alehon bishin machtashay eshetze vehon
Meze raav ulechume reshef veketev meriri veshen-behemot ashallach-bam im-chamat zochale afar
Nifiche chafan vaachule uf uchetishe ruchin bishan veshen chevat bara egare behon im chamat tanninayya dezachalin beafra
Michutz teshakkel-cherev umechadarim ema gam-bachur gam-betula yonek im-ish seva
Mibbara tetakkel charba umittevanayya chargat mota af ulemehon af ulemathon yankehon im enash savehon
Amarti afehem ashbita meenosh zichram
Amarit echul ragzi alehon veeshetzinnun evattal mibbene anasha ducheranehon
Lule kaas oyev agur pen-yenakkeru tzaremo pen-yomru yadenu rama velo Adonai paal kol-zot
Illulafon ragza dessana kenish dilma yitravrav beel devava dilma yemrun yedana tekifat lana vela min kodam Adonai havat kol da
Ki-go ovad etzot hemma veen bahem tevuna
Are am meabbede etza innun velet behon sucheletanu
Lu chachmu yaskilu zot yavinu leacharitam
Illu chakkimu istakkalu veda sevaru ma yehe vessofehon
Echa yirdof echad elef ushenayim yanissu revava im-lo ki-tzuram mecharam va-Adonai hisguiram
Echden yirdof chad alfa uteren yeerkun leribbota ellahen are takkifhon messarinnun va-Adonai ashleminnun
Ki lo chetzurenu tzuram veoyvenu pelilim
Are la chetakpana takpehon uvaale devavana havo dayyanana
Ki-migguefen sedom gafnam umishshadmot amora anavemo inneve-rosh ashkelot merorot lamo
Are chefuranut amma disdom puranutehon velakutehon keam amra machathon bishin kereshe chevyan vetushlamat ovadehon kimrarutehon
Chamat tanninim yenam verosh petanim achzar
Ha chemarat tanninayya ks puranutehon ucheresh petane chevyan achzera'in
Halo-hu kamus immadi chatum beotzrotay
Hala chol ovadehon guelan kodamay guenizin leom dina beotzray
Li nakam veshillem leet tamut raglam ki karov yom edam vechash atidot lamo
Kodamay puranuta vaana ashallem le'iddan deyiglun mearahon are kariv yom tevarhon umabba deatid lehon
Ki-yadin Adonai ammo veal-avadav yitnecham ki yire ki-azlat yad veefes atzur veazuv
Are yedin Adonai dina deammehh ufuranut avdohi tzaddikayya yitpera are gueli kodamohi dividdan dititkef alehon machat sana yehon mittaltelin ushevikin
Veamar e elohemo tzur chassayu vo
Veyemar an dachalathon takkifa dahavo rechitzin behh
Asher chelev zevachemo yochelu yishtu yen nessicham yakumu veyazeruchem yehi alechem sitra
Di terav nichsathon havo achlin shatan chamar niskehon yekumun kean vissaadunechon yehon alechon maguen
Reu atta ki ani ani hu veen elohim immadi ani amit vaachayye machatzti vaani erpa veen miyyadi matztzil
Chazo kean are ana ana hu velet elahh bar minni ana memit umechayye machena veaf massena velet min yedi meshezev
Ki-essa el-shamayim yadi veamarti chay anochi leolam
Are atkenit bishmayya bet shechinti vaamarit kayyam ana lealmin
Im-shannoti berak charbi vetochez bemishpat yadi ashiv nakam letzaray velimsanay ashallem
Im al chad teren kechezu varka missof shemayya vead sof shemayya titgueli charbi vetitkef bedina yedi atev puranuta lessanay ulevaale devavay eshallem
Ashkir chitztzay middam vecharbi tochal bassar middam chalal veshivya merosh parot oyev
Eravve guiray middema vecharbi tiktol beammayya middam ketilan veshivyan leadaa chitrin meresh sana uveel devava
Harninu goyim ammo ki dam-avadav yikkom venakam yashiv letzarav vechipper admato ammo
Shabbachu ammayya ammehh are puranut avdohi tzaddikayya yitpera ufuranut yatev lessanohi vichappar al arehh veal ammehh
